newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands says Placer bid inadequate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands says Placer bid inadequate.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd said on Thursday the 75 cent per share takeover bid by Canada's Placer Dome Inc was inadequate and undervalued the company's long-term potential.
Highlands chairman Clive Hildebrand said shareholders were advised to ignore any documents or announcements issued by Placer and not to sell their shares in the market.

"The board of Highlands Gold, which is being advised by Rothschild Australia Ltd, believes the terms of this unsolicited offer are inadequate and significantly undervalue Highlands Gold's long-term potential," the company said in a statement.
The board of the Papua New Guinea gold miner said its detailed views would be set out in its formal response to the offer document.
Placer Dome's bid values Highlands at about A$425 million.
The Canadian gold miner also made an offer to mop up the 24.6 percent of its Australian offshoot Placer Pacific Ltd that it does not already own.
If Placer Dome succeeds in its bid it would gain control of 50 percent of the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea, in which both Placer Pacific and Highlands have a 25 percent share.
Highlands shares were 17 cents stronger at A$0.75 at 2.50 p.m. (0350 GMT).
